name: 8thAlice
source:
Alice was having a good time with her sister as usual. Then, she realized she wandered into Wonderland.

The White Rabbit asked her to finish the story, so she started chasing after him, as it goes...
Will she be able to complete her mission...? Or will she be devoured by Wonderland...?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5713]NovelGame[/url]]
